info.title: OpenSprite local AI settings API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP contract for one atomic local model selection, context budget, output budget, bounded output continuation, response delivery preference, full prompt logging preference and response mode setting.

requirements: Runtime and installer configurations must bind only to loopback addresses.
Deployments must reject non-loopback Host values and cross-origin browser mutations before AI settings routes become operational.

x-compatibility.policy: This rebuild is new-install-only. The removed model-only route and schema are intentionally unsupported.

x-events.description: This contract defines no event, webhook, or WebSocket delivery behavior.

tags.name: ai-settings
tags.description: One atomic local model selection, response mode and response delivery setting.

get.description: Returns a null model, default response mode and stream response delivery when no settings file exists. The read is side-effect free.

put.description: A non-null model requires a currently connected Provider. A null model preserves and persists the supplied response mode.

200.description: The requested values are now the confirmed local AI settings.

ResponseMode.description: default means future inference requests omit provider reasoning-strength parameters.

ResponseDelivery.description: stream displays assistant deltas as they arrive; complete displays the assembled response after the Run reaches a terminal state.

contextBudget.description: OpenSprite context-use ceiling for this model selection; max still reserves output and safety space.

outputBudget.description: Requested response-token budget; the backend still caps it to the selected model and safe Context capacity.

logFullPrompts.description: Whether complete model request messages are written to local per-request Prompt logs.

NotConnected.description: The selected Provider is not connected.

SettingsStoreUnavailable.description: The local AI settings file is unavailable.

SettingsOrCredentialStoreUnavailable.description: AI settings or Provider state could not be safely accessed.

InternalError.description: An unexpected local backend error occurred.
